title: Do not stay attached to windows for long
text: Do not stay attached to windows for long. Most of these peeled off in a week or two and I have been replacing them gradually. Once they peel off they are brittle and can’t be reused. They are opaque but not UV reflective as far as I can tell. They seem to work but they just don’t stay on well.

product_metadata.title: Large Size Anti-Collision Window Clings Bird Window Stickers Prevent Bird Strikes on Doors Windows Glass Translucent/ Dusted Window Decals Alert Bird Stickers HR1708 Large Size Anti-Collision Window Clings Bird Window Stickers Prevent Bird Strikes on Door
features: What you can get: there are 40 electrostatic stickers with 20 different shapes of birds pattern, each anti-collision window clings offer a vivid design for your home window decor

Easy to assemble: first, clean the window with a duster; Second, spray a mist of water on the glass; Then peel the anti-collision window cling from the vinyl backing and place it on the window in any design you like; If you want to rearrange it, simply peel it off and move it around

Transparent matte design: the specially designed reflective material in each window cling reflects ultraviolet sunlight as glowing warning sign for birds; To humans they appear as frosted or etched glass

Range of application: the anti-collision stickers prevent bird and people strikes; Paste them to glass panels, verandah doors or bay windows, can act like mirrors with the sun rays reflection; The window birds stickers also can decorate your windows or glass doors
Note: when you attach the window clings to the glass, make sure that the distance between them is not more than 6 inches, so as to maximize the effectiveness of preventing birds strike on windows
